manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least once this game.
description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Replication Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake and Replication Technique's demonstrate ability trigger, copying Replication Technique at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Replication Technique spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.
